tradeoptimizer.picker.title: Trade Picker
tradeoptimizer.config.title: Trade Picker Settings
tradeoptimizer.config.vanillaPricing.tip:
OFF (default): every trade shows the lowest possible vanilla price.
ON: trades use vanilla's randomized price range. Prices are seeded per villager and trade, so the picker preview always matches what you pay.

Note: this setting is server-side. On a dedicated server it must be changed in config/tradeoptimizer.json on the server directly.
OFF (default): you can choose up to two enchanted books at every villager level.
ON: the number of book picks per level is capped to how many book trades vanilla actually offers there (usually one), so the rest of your picks must be non-book trades — a vanilla-accurate librarian economy.

Note: this setting is server-side. On a dedicated server it must be changed in config/tradeoptimizer.json on the server directly.
